notes.title: "Milo's Tiny Fish Pond" is Officially Released!
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are thrilled to announce that
"Milo's Tiny Fish Pond" is now officially released worldwide on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565101/4369a28d078058055f73fbf3f7492af2716bb58a.png[/img]

Whether you’re a seasoned fish pond enthusiast or simply looking for a wholesome and relaxing casual game to ease your stress, you can now nurture your very own family of tiny fish on your desktop and enjoy the healing companionship they bring at any time!

🐟 Game Features at a Glance
Ultra-casual idle experience: Your fish grow and accumulate coins automatically, even when you’re offline!
Collect a variety of fish cards: Over 300 types of fish await, each with unique appearances and personalities—every unboxing brings a new surprise!
Simple interactive mechanics: Click the water’s surface to feed your fish and enjoy their cute scramble for food.
Customizable pond decorations: Freely mix and match aquatic plants, decor, and backgrounds to create your own unique aquatic world.
Desktop companion mode: Keep the game window on your desktop as a charming companion throughout your work or study sessions.
Fun for all ages: Relaxed and stress-free gameplay—anyone can enjoy the gentle pace of digital fish keeping!

💌 A Word from Us
This is a small but heartfelt indie project created by MMUnit Studio. We hope to bring a bit of warmth and comfort to your digital life in the simplest way possible.
If you enjoy the game, please leave a comment below or join our community to share your fish-keeping stories with us! For any issues, feel free to contact us anytime.

Thank you to everyone who wishlisted, playtested, and provided us with valuable feedback—your support has brought our tiny fish pond to life!

👉 Click to visit our Steam store page and play or purchase now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3573000/_/

Start your fish collection journey today and let these lively little creatures become your new digital companions!

Thank you again for your attention and support!
Wishing you plenty of fish and a calm, peaceful mind every day!

Sincerely,
The MMUnit Team
